== Biography ==
John was born about 1827. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2603|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Lamb-11245|Mary Lamb]]. He passed away in 1910.
== Research Notes ==
=== Current paternal evidence ===
The father relationship to [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 90% (confident). John Glasgow's baptism on 8 October 1826 at Manchester Cathedral is indexed to Robert Glasgow and Mary, the couple of Robert [[Glasgow-2603]] and Mary Lamb, whose further children Adam (1829), Isabella (1834), Mary Maria (1836) and Ann (1839) were baptised at Manchester to Robert and Mary. That parent-naming baptism, his 1827 Manchester birth, the 1841 Manchester household and the 1842 Bombay family grouping raise the father link from 81% to 90%.

Index transcript only; the cathedral register is uninspected and John's 1910 death registration is not transcribed for parents. Robert's own parentage is separate. No mother change follows.
<ref>[https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Ddeaths NZ death registration 1910/4944 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Ddeaths)].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9841/records/125802717 England, Select Births and Christenings, 1538-1975 — John Glasgow, 8 Oct 1826, Cathedral,Manchester,Lancashire,England].</ref>

The dated reviews below describe earlier stages of this research.


=== Earlier father review, 22 October 2026 ===

In this earlier review, the father [[Glasgow-2603]] is assessed at 81% (probable). The held account assigns John Glasgow to Robert Glasgow and Mary Lamb in the Bombay/Turakina family. John’s 1827 Manchester birth and Bombay family grouping fit, but his 1910 death registration is not transcribed for parents.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.

Earlier proposed test: Inspect the 1842 Bombay passenger family list and the child’s NZ death certificate parent fields.

Source basis already held: [https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Ddeaths NZ death registration 1910/4944 (https://www.bdmhistoricalrecords.dia.govt.nz/search/search?path=%2FqueryEntry.m%3Ftype%3Ddeaths)]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
